# appleads_ad_group_report (Data Source)

Reads Apple Ads ad group-level performance within a campaign.

Read-only snapshot from `POST /api/v5/reports/campaigns/{campaignId}/adgroups`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_ad_group_report" "generic" {
  campaign_id = "1234567890"
  start_time  = "2026-09-01"
  end_time    = "2026-09-14"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) Parent campaign id.
- `end_time` (String) Report end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `start_time` (String) Report start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

### Optional

- `time_zone` (String) Report time zone. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `ad_groups` (Attributes List) Ad group rows for the window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_groups))
- `id` (String) Composite id `campaign_id/start_time/end_time`.

<a id="nestedatt--ad_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ad_groups`

Read-Only:

- `ad_group_id` (String) Ad group id.
- `avg_cpa_amount` (String) Average CPA / CPI as a decimal string (`totalAvgCPI`).
- `avg_cpa_currency` (String) Average CPA currency.
- `avg_cpt_amount` (String) Average CPT as a decimal string.
- `avg_cpt_currency` (String) Average CPT currency.
- `conversion_rate` (Number) Conversion rate.
- `impressions` (Number) Impressions in the report window.
- `installs` (Number) Total installs (tap + view) in the report window.
- `local_spend_amount` (String) Spend as a decimal string.
- `local_spend_currency` (String) Spend currency.
- `name` (String) Ad group name.
- `taps` (Number) Taps in the report window.
- `ttr` (Number) Tap-through rate.
